π.m: Lowercase pi (πεῖ), the 16th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the voiceless unaspirated bilabial plosive /p/. It is preceded by ο and followed by ρ

n: The letter pi (πεῖ), the 16th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.
A digit 5 in the decimal acrophonic numeral system that predated the gematria system. An abbreviation of πέντε (pénte, “five”). Equivalent to the Roman digit V.

π̅.m: Lowercase pi (πεῖ), the 16th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the voiceless unaspirated bilabial plosive /p/. It is preceded by ο and followed by ρ
